papers.title: A proteomic polygenic score to identify IL-18 driven inflammatory bowel disease
papers.translated_title: 一种用于识别IL-18驱动的炎症性肠病的蛋白质组多基因评分
papers.author: Turchin, M. C.
papers.summary: High levels of IL-18 have been causally implicated in IBD risk and may represent a unique mechanism driving IBD yet to be therapeutically targeted. To identify individuals predisposed to increased levels of IL-18, we implemented a polygenic approach to predict IL-18 plasma protein levels. Using a dataset with over 50,000 individuals with both genetic and plasma protein levels from Olink, we developed a 27 SNP polygenic score that predicts IL-18 levels and IBD risk. Further, we identified a threshold to classify patients as 'IL-18 High' using a data-driven approach that optimized prediction of both IL-18 and IBD risk. We show that ~30% of the overall IBD patient population is 'IL-18 High', meaning a genetic predisposition towards higher protein levels. The IL-18 PGS and corresponding threshold have the potential to identify IBD patients with IL-18-driven IBD that may respond more effectively to a therapy targeting this mechanism.
papers.translated_summary: 高水平的IL-18已被证实与IBD风险存在因果关系，并可能代表一种驱动IBD的独特机制，但目前尚未成为治疗靶点。为识别具有IL-18水平升高易感性的个体，我们采用多基因方法预测IL-18血浆蛋白水平。利用一个包含超过50,000名个体遗传数据和Olink血浆蛋白水平的数据集，我们开发了一个由27个SNP组成的多基因评分，可预测IL-18水平和IBD风险。此外，我们通过数据驱动方法确定了一个阈值，将患者分类为“IL-18高”，该方法优化了对IL-18和IBD风险的预测。我们显示，约30%的IBD患者总体人群为“IL-18高”，意味着具有较高蛋白水平的遗传易感性。IL-18 PGS及相应阈值有潜力识别具有IL-18驱动型IBD的IBD患者，这些患者可能对针对该机制的治疗反应更有效。

papers.title: Identifying cohorts at elevated risk of cancers using generative modeling of patient health states
papers.translated_title: 利用患者健康状态的生成建模识别癌症高风险队列
papers.author: Khan, A.
papers.summary: While large language models are powerful generators of new text, forecasting disease progression from longitudinal health histories remains a challenging problem. We introduce GenEHR, an autoregressive generative model trained on electronic health records (EHRs) from millions of patients in diverse health systems. The model learns from real-world multimodal patient histories, including diagnoses, medications, lab values, and procedures while explicitly representing irregular intervals between visits to forecast future clinical events. We combine the general-purpose patient representation learned during foundational training with parameter-efficient supervised adaptation for the task of risk stratification for 17 cancer types. In five large EHR cohorts, supervised adaptation substantially improved prediction performance of a first cancer diagnosis within a five year horizon window. Our retrospective results support the prospective evaluation of GenEHR-CancerRisk as a clinical decision-support tool for prioritizing high-risk patients for screening and prevention of aggressive cancer types, such as pancreatic and ovarian cancer.
papers.translated_summary: 尽管大型语言模型是强大的新文本生成器，但从纵向健康史预测疾病进展仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。我们提出GenEHR，一种在来自多元医疗系统数百万患者电子健康记录（EHR）上训练的自回归生成模型。该模型从真实世界的多模态患者病史中学习，包括诊断、药物、实验室检查值和操作程序，同时显式表示就诊之间的不规则间隔，以预测未来的临床事件。我们将基础训练期间学习到的通用患者表征与参数高效的监督适配相结合，用于17种癌症类型的风险分层任务。在五个大型EHR队列中，监督适配显著提高了五年时间窗内首次癌症诊断的预测性能。我们的回顾性结果支持对GenEHR-CancerRisk作为临床决策支持工具进行前瞻性评估，以优先筛选高风险患者进行筛查和预防侵袭性癌症类型，如胰腺癌和卵巢癌。

papers.title: Coordinated Cytokine Responses Are Associated With Rapid HIV Reservoir Decay During Acute Treated HIV Infection
papers.translated_title: 协调的细胞因子反应与急性期治疗HIV感染期间快速HIV储存库衰减相关
papers.author: Barbehenn, A.
papers.summary: Background: The HIV reservoir is established within days of infection and persists despite antiretroviral therapy (ART). Host immune responses associated with early reservoir decay remain poorly defined. Methods: We analyzed >500 longitudinal blood samples from 67 individuals treated during acute HIV infection. Plasma cytokines and HIV reservoir size (intact and defective DNA) were quantified longitudinally. Cytokine-reservoir relationships were assessed using unsupervised clustering and complementary mixed-effects nonlinear and linear spline models; counterfactual modeling examined how cytokine concentrations at defined timepoints related to subsequent reservoir trajectories. Results: TNF-, IL-17A, and IL-10 were significantly associated with intact HIV DNA during the first 24 weeks of ART after false-discovery-rate correction. TNF- showed one of the strongest associations with intact reservoir decay, whereas IL-10 showed the most consistent association across intact and defective HIV DNA. A coordinated cytokine cluster comprising IFN-{gamma}, IL-10, IL-18, and TNF- was associated with both reservoir measures. Phase-specific and counterfactual analyses further suggested that associations between several cytokines and reservoir dynamics varied with timing during early ART. These relationships persisted after adjustment for ART initiation timing, baseline viremia, initial CD4+ T-cell count, and longitudinal CD4:CD8 ratio. Discussion: Coordinated inflammatory, antiviral, and immunoregulatory cytokine responses are associated with HIV reservoir decay following ART initiation during acute infection, with some relationships varying over time. These findings may inform future stage-specific HIV cure strategies that leverage the timing and balance of antiviral, inflammatory, and immunoregulatory pathways to limit reservoir persistence.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：HIV储存库在感染后数天内即建立，并尽管接受抗逆转录病毒治疗（ART）仍持续存在。与早期储存库衰减相关的宿主免疫反应仍定义不清。方法：我们分析了来自67名在急性HIV感染期间接受治疗的个体的500多份纵向血液样本。纵向定量了血浆细胞因子和HIV储存库大小（完整和缺陷DNA）。使用无监督聚类以及互补的混合效应非线性和线性样条模型评估了细胞因子-储存库关系；反事实建模检验了特定时间点的细胞因子浓度如何与随后的储存库轨迹相关。结果：在错误发现率校正后，TNF-、IL-17A和IL-10在ART最初24周内与完整HIV DNA显著相关。TNF-与完整储存库衰减的关联最强之一，而IL-10在完整和缺陷HIV DNA中表现出最一致的关联。由IFN-{gamma}、IL-10、IL-18和TNF-组成的协调细胞因子簇与两种储存库指标均相关。阶段特异性和反事实分析进一步表明，几种细胞因子与储存库动态之间的关联随早期ART期间的时间而变化。在调整ART启动时间、基线病毒血症、初始CD4+ T细胞计数和纵向CD4:CD8比值后，这些关系持续存在。讨论：协调的炎症、抗病毒和免疫调节细胞因子反应与急性感染期间ART启动后的HIV储存库衰减相关，其中一些关系随时间变化。这些发现可能为未来的阶段特异性HIV治愈策略提供信息，这些策略利用抗病毒、炎症和免疫调节通路的时间和平衡来限制储存库持续存在。

papers.title: Community burden of diphtheria during the 2023-24 epidemic in Kano State, Nigeria: a population-based household survey
papers.translated_title: 2023-24年尼日利亚卡诺州白喉疫情期间的社区负担：一项基于人群的家庭调查
papers.author: Hudu, S.
papers.summary: Background Since late 2022, Nigeria has experienced one of its largest recorded diphtheria epidemics, centred on Kano State, where facility-based surveillance documented over 18,000 cases between February 2022 and April 2024. The true community burden remains unknown. We conducted a population-based household survey to estimate community attack rates, mortality, vaccination coverage, and determinants of infection and death. Methods and Findings We performed a retrospective household survey (September-October 2024) in four Local Government Areas (LGAs) using spatially randomised cluster sampling (78 clusters; recall from January 2023). Survey-weighted logistic regression adjusted for age group, sex, vaccination, LGA, socioeconomic quintile, and household size. We enrolled 7,998 individuals from 1,068 households (cooperation rate 98.6%). Among 7,889 with known diphtheria status, the community attack rate was 1.1% (95% confidence interval [CI] [0.7,1.4]). The attack rate was 3.1 times (95% CI [2.1,4.1]) that notified at three Medecins Sans Frontieres-supported sites over the same period. The case fatality ratio was 8.7% (95% CI [3.9,18.5]; 8/88) overall and 21.3% (95% CI [5.1,57.5]; 3/15) under five. Of 110 all-cause deaths, 62.5% occurred at home, as did 4 of 8 diphtheria deaths, all after seeking care. Care-seeking delays of [≥]4 days were associated with higher case mortality (risk ratio 24.3, 95% CI [2.97,199]; p=0.004). Exploratory all-cause and diphtheria-specific mortality rate ratios (reported unvaccinated versus vaccinated) were 2.03 (95% CI [1.19,3.48]) and 1.00 (95% CI [0.21,4.80]). Routine immunisation coverage was 38.0%; 45.7% (95% CI [38.9,52.5]) of 3,287 children were reported as unvaccinated. The main limitation is that diphtheria, cause of death, and vaccination status were respondent-reported without laboratory or record confirmation. Conclusions Community diphtheria burden appeared to exceed facility surveillance estimates, and most all-cause deaths occurred at home. Delayed care-seeking was associated with diphtheria mortality, highlighting the need for improved community surveillance, decentralised care, and better-targeted vaccination.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 自2022年末以来，尼日利亚经历了有记录以来最大规模的白喉疫情之一，以卡诺州为中心，2022年2月至2024年4月期间，基于医疗机构的监测记录了超过18,000例病例。真实的社区疾病负担仍不清楚。我们开展了一项基于人群的家庭调查，以估计社区发病率、死亡率、疫苗接种覆盖率以及感染和死亡的决定因素。方法与发现 我们于2024年9月至10月在四个地方政府区（LGA）开展了一项回顾性家庭调查，采用空间随机整群抽样（78个群组；回顾至2023年1月）。调查加权逻辑回归对年龄组、性别、疫苗接种、LGA、社会经济五分位数和家庭规模进行了调整。我们招募了来自1,068户家庭的7,998人（合作率98.6%）。在7,889名白喉状态已知者中，社区发病率为1.1%（95%置信区间[CI][0.7,1.4]）。该发病率是同期三个无国界医生组织支持点报告发病率的3.1倍（95%CI[2.1,4.1]）。总病死率为8.7%（95%CI[3.9,18.5]；8/88），五岁以下儿童为21.3%（95%CI[5.1,57.5]；3/15）。在110例全因死亡中，62.5%发生在家中，8例白喉死亡中有4例亦发生在家中，且均发生在寻求医疗照护之后。寻求照护延迟≥4天与较高的病例死亡率相关（风险比24.3，95%CI[2.97,199]；p=0.004）。探索性全因死亡率和白喉特异性死亡率比（报告未接种疫苗与已接种疫苗相比）分别为2.03（95%CI[1.19,3.48]）和1.00（95%CI[0.21,4.80]）。常规免疫覆盖率为38.0%；3,287名儿童中有45.7%（95%CI[38.9,52.5]）被报告为未接种疫苗。主要局限性在于白喉、死因和疫苗接种状态均为受访者报告，未经实验室或记录确认。结论 社区白喉负担似乎超过了医疗机构监测估计值，且大多数全因死亡发生在家中。延迟寻求照护与白喉死亡相关，凸显了改善社区监测、分散化照护和更有针对性疫苗接种的必要性。

papers.title: Semaglutide and non-arteritic anterior ischaemic optic neuropathy: a 121-fold reporting signal and a bounded genetic null
papers.translated_title: 司美格鲁肽与非动脉炎性前部缺血性视神经病变：121倍报告信号与有界遗传学零结果
papers.author: Jiang, J.
papers.summary: Background. A cohort study on 3 July 2024 linked semaglutide to non-arteritic anterior ischaemic optic neuropathy (NAION), and in June 2025 the European Medicines Agency (EMA) accepted NAION as a very rare side effect, about one additional case per 10,000 person-years. Objective. To measure how much of the signal the reporting system generates itself, test whether three reporting systems are independent, and let a genetic instrument adjudicate rather than corroborate. Methods. FAERS (12,305,041 reports, 2018Q1 to 2026Q2), JADER (1,054,239 reports), and VigiAccess counts were analysed with reporting odds ratios, covariate-adjusted regression, and pre-specified probes. Six cis-eQTL variants for GLP1R expression instrumented anterior ischaemic optic neuropathy (AION, 244 cases) and five AION-spectrum traits, with colocalisation. Results. Semaglutide carried 879 NAION reports and a reporting odds ratio of 120.8 (95% CI 110.6 to 132.0), about sixty times the relative risk the EMA accepted, and the odds that a report named NAION rose 48.6-fold afterwards. VigiBase held 871 such reports where FAERS held 879, and the two systems give opposite accounts of the GLP-1 class. Of fifteen observations separating toxicity from reporting dynamics, one favoured reporting dynamics, two favoured toxicity weakly, two bounded an expression-mediated mechanism, and ten decided nothing. GLP1R expression was unassociated with AION (0.56, 0.21 to 1.49), a null powered only above fourfold, while glaucoma was bounded (1.05, 0.87 to 1.25) and no relevant ocular trait colocalised. Conclusions. Semaglutide's NAION signal is amplified by the reporting system, and the databases that appear to corroborate it hold the same records, so the causal question stays open in both directions.
papers.translated_summary: 背景。2024年7月3日的一项队列研究将司美格鲁肽与非动脉炎性前部缺血性视神经病变（NAION）相关联，2025年6月欧洲药品管理局（EMA）将NAION认定为一种非常罕见的副作用，约为每10,000人年增加一例。目的。测量报告系统自身产生了多少信号，检验三个报告系统是否独立，并让遗传工具进行裁定而非佐证。方法。采用报告比值比、协变量校正回归和预设探针分析FAERS（12,305,041份报告，2018Q1至2026Q2）、JADER（1,054,239份报告）和VigiAccess计数。使用六个GLP1R表达的顺式eQTL变异作为工具变量分析前部缺血性视神经病变（AION，244例）和五个AION谱系特征，并进行共定位分析。结果。司美格鲁肽携带879份NAION报告，报告比值比为120.8（95% CI 110.6至132.0），约为EMA所接受相对风险的六十倍，且此后报告提及NAION的比值上升了48.6倍。VigiBase持有871份此类报告，而FAERS持有879份，两个系统对GLP-1类药物的描述相反。在区分毒性与报告动力学的十五项观察中，一项支持报告动力学，两项弱支持毒性，两项界定了一种表达介导的机制，十项未能判定任何结论。GLP1R表达与AION无关联（0.56，0.21至1.49），该零结果仅在四倍以上才具有检验效能，而青光眼受到界定（1.05，0.87至1.25），且无相关眼部特征共定位。结论。司美格鲁肽的NAION信号被报告系统放大，而看似佐证该信号的数据库持有相同的记录，因此因果问题在两个方向上均悬而未决。

papers.title: Social and behavioral risk factors are associated with age-related differences in sustained attention: A cross-sectional GradCPT analysis of the All of Us dataset
papers.translated_title: 社会和行为风险因素与持续注意力的年龄相关差异有关：All of Us数据集的横断面GradCPT分析
papers.author: Coresh-Chiappori, N. M.
papers.summary: Background Attentional control declines with normal aging, yet the role of modifiable lifestyle factors in accelerating this decline remains incompletely characterised in large, diverse populations. We examined associations between four modifiable risk factors (smoking intensity, alcohol binge drinking, social satisfaction and blood pressure) and sustained attention performance in 13,866 adults drawn from the All of Us Research Program. Methods Cognitive performance was assessed using the Gradual-Onset Continuous Performance Task (GradCPT). A composite cognitive efficiency score was derived via principal component analysis of four GradCPT metrics: d' (perceptual sensitivity), response criterion, median reaction time and reaction time variability. Associations between cognitive efficiency and each risk factor were examined using multiple linear regression adjusted for age, sex and race/ethnicity. Effect sizes were expressed as age-equivalent years of cognitive aging (age-equivalent years = regression coefficient for the risk factor divided by the regression coefficient for age) to aid clinical interpretation. Results GradCPT performance declined progressively with age (p < 0.001). Social satisfaction emerged as the strongest lifestyle predictor: low social satisfaction was associated with approximately 5.8 additional age-equivalent years of cognitive aging relative to high social satisfaction. Smoking showed a dose-response pattern, with heavy smokers (> 20 cigarettes/day) exhibiting an approximately 5-year age-equivalent deficit versus never-smokers. Stage 2 hypertension showed a modest, non-significant negative association. Binge drinking showed limited significant associations, likely complicated by survivor and abstainer biases. Bootstrapped analyses of combined exposures showed that combinations of risk factors, particularly those involving low social satisfaction, produced larger cognitive deficits than expected under an additive model. Conclusions These findings support an interactive rather than a purely additive model of lifestyle-related cognitive vulnerability and highlight the GradCPT as a subclinical measure of attention-based cognitive risk in non-clinical populations. Keywords Cognitive aging, Sustained attention, GradCPT, Modifiable risk factors, Social isolation, Smoking, Hypertension, All of Us Research Program
papers.translated_summary: 背景 注意控制能力随正常衰老而下降，但可改变的生活方式因素在加速这一下降中的作用，在大型、多样化人群中仍未得到充分描述。我们研究了四种可改变风险因素（吸烟强度、酒精暴饮、社会满意度和血压）与13，866名来自All of Us Research Program的成年人持续注意表现之间的关联。方法 认知表现采用渐变起始持续操作任务（GradCPT）进行评估。通过对四项GradCPT指标（d'（知觉敏感性）、反应标准、中位反应时和反应时变异性）进行主成分分析，得出一个复合认知效率评分。认知效率与各风险因素之间的关联采用多元线性回归分析，并对年龄、性别和种族/族裔进行了校正。效应量以年龄等效的认知衰老年数表示（年龄等效年数=风险因素的回归系数除以年龄的回归系数），以助于临床解读。结果 GradCPT表现随年龄增长而逐步下降（p<0.001）。社会满意度是最强的生活方式预测因素：与社会满意度高相比，社会满意度低与约5.8个额外的年龄等效认知衰老年数相关。吸烟呈现剂量-反应模式，重度吸烟者（>20支/天）相对于从不吸烟者表现出约5年的年龄等效缺陷。2级高血压显示出适度的、非显著的负相关。暴饮显示出有限的相关性，可能因幸存者偏倚和戒酒者偏倚而变得复杂。对联合暴露的Bootstrap分析显示，风险因素的组合，尤其是涉及低社会满意度的组合，产生的认知缺陷大于加性模型下的预期。结论 这些发现支持生活方式相关认知脆弱性的交互模型而非纯加性模型，并强调GradCPT可作为非临床人群中基于注意的认知风险的亚临床测量工具。关键词 认知衰老，持续注意，GradCPT，可改变风险因素，社会隔离，吸烟，高血压，All of Us Research Program

papers.title: Patient-specific finite element modeling of image-derived shell morphoelastic growth: A general framework and application to stented aortic dissection
papers.translated_title: 患者特异性有限元建模：基于影像衍生的壳形态弹性生长——通用框架及其在支架置入主动脉夹层中的应用
papers.author: Gaffney, A. D.
papers.summary: Vascular pathology often manifests in complex shape evolution visualized by longitudinal computed tomography (CT) imaging. Growth and remodeling (G&R) frameworks have been integrated into finite element (FE) modeling to probe the mechanics underlying this progression, extending into patient-specific approaches. Their scalability and translatability, however, are limited by the computational burden associated with heterogeneous, anisotropic growth fields and through-thickness meshing. While existing shell growth formulations can mitigate this burden, they require nontrivial FE implementation especially in commercial softwares (e.g., Abaqus) and their efficacy in patient-specific geometries under complex loading is unclear. In this work, we present a general computational framework to implement shell morphoelastic growth computed directly from registered patient-specific CT images. This shell implementation is validated against solid 3D formulations, allows thickness tunability, and increases compatibility with CT surfaces. We demonstrate the robustness of this formulation through modeling post-operative growth in a patient-specific aortic dissection under stent-based loading. Results first show that complex stent-based loading can deform the shell dissection flap to reproduce post-operative geometry. The outer aortic wall is then given a growth field calculated from registration of 1-month and 5-year post-operative CT images, which is implemented along with stent-based loading and pressurization. Results from this model capture the trends in total and lumen morphological evolution observed at intermediate timepoints. These findings establish a general framework, validated with a patient-specific case study of aortic dissection, with the potential to expand to other complex systems, scale to larger patient populations, and apply G&R to clinical translation.
papers.translated_summary: 血管病理常表现为复杂的形态演化，可通过纵向计算机断层扫描（CT）成像进行可视化。生长与重塑（G&R）框架已被整合到有限元（FE）建模中，以探究这一进展背后的力学机制，并扩展到患者特异性方法。然而，其可扩展性和可转化性受到与异质性、各向异性生长场以及厚度方向网格划分相关的计算负担的限制。虽然现有的壳生长公式可以减轻这一负担，但它们需要非平凡的有限元实现，尤其是在商业软件（如 Abaqus）中，并且其在复杂载荷下患者特异性几何中的有效性尚不清楚。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个通用的计算框架，用于实现直接从配准的患者特异性 CT 图像计算得到的壳形态弹性生长。该壳实现针对实体三维公式进行了验证，允许厚度可调，并提高了与 CT 表面的兼容性。我们通过模拟患者特异性主动脉夹层在支架载荷下的术后生长，证明了该公式的稳健性。结果首先表明，复杂的支架载荷可以使壳夹层瓣变形，从而再现术后几何形态。然后，根据 1 个月和 5 年术后 CT 图像的配准计算外主动脉壁的生长场，并将其与支架载荷和加压一起实施。该模型的结果捕捉了在中间时间点观察到的总体形态和管腔形态演化的趋势。这些发现建立了一个通用框架，并通过主动脉夹层的患者特异性案例研究进行了验证，具有扩展到其他复杂系统、扩展到更大患者群体以及将 G&R 应用于临床转化的潜力。

papers.title: Factors Associated with Stunting, Underweight, and Wasting Among Children Under Five in Bangladesh: Evidence from the MICS 2025 Survey
papers.translated_title: 与孟加拉国五岁以下儿童发育迟缓、体重不足和消瘦相关的因素：来自MICS 2025调查的证据
papers.author: Oshan, Y. A.
papers.summary: Background: Childhood malnutrition remains a major public health concern in Bangladesh despite two decades of progress. Using the latest nationally representative data from Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey (MICS) 2025, this study assesses the prevalence of stunting, underweight, and wasting among children under five and examines their association with child, maternal, household, and regional characteristics.. Methods: We analyzed data on 21,736 children under five years of age from MICS 2025. Rao-Scott chi-squared tests and survey-weighted multivariable logistic regression were used to examine associations between socio-demographic factors and each malnutrition outcome. Results: Weighted prevalence was 24% for stunting, 23% for underweight, and 13% for wasting. Stunting peaked at 12-35 months (AOR = 2.13, 95% CI: 1.82-2.50 for 12-23 months), whereas underweight was highest at 48-59 months (AOR = 1.88, 95% CI: 1.60-2.22). Girls had lower odds than boys of stunting (AOR = 0.92, 95% CI: 0.85-0.99), underweight (AOR = 0.93, 95% CI: 0.86-1.00), and wasting (AOR = 0.84, 95% CI: 0.76-0.92). Children from the richest households had substantially lower odds of stunting (AOR = 0.48, 95% CI: 0.41-0.56), underweight (AOR = 0.50, 95% CI: 0.42-0.58), and wasting (AOR = 0.71, 95% CI: 0.59-0.86). Maternal higher secondary education or above was protective against stunting (AOR = 0.57, 95% CI: 0.47-0.69) and underweight (AOR = 0.63, 95% CI: 0.51-0.76). Children in Sylhet had higher odds of stunting (AOR = 1.37, 95% CI: 1.15-1.64) and underweight (AOR = 1.40, 95% CI: 1.18-1.67) than those in Barishal. Conclusions: Household wealth, children sex and birth order, maternal education, and geographic division are the main correlates of child malnutrition in Bangladesh. Equity-focused, region-specific interventions and continued national surveillance are needed to accelerate progress toward SDG 2.2.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：尽管二十年来取得了进展，儿童营养不良仍然是孟加拉国的一个主要公共卫生问题。本研究利用2025年多指标类集调查（MICS）的最新全国代表性数据，评估五岁以下儿童发育迟缓、体重不足和消瘦的患病率，并考察其与儿童、母亲、家庭和地区特征之间的关联。方法：我们分析了MICS 2025中21736名五岁以下儿童的数据。采用Rao-Scott卡方检验和调查加权多变量logistic回归，考察社会人口因素与各项营养不良结局之间的关联。结果：加权患病率分别为发育迟缓24%、体重不足23%、消瘦13%。发育迟缓在12-35个月达到峰值（12-23个月的AOR=2.13，95% CI：1.82-2.50），而体重不足在48-59个月最高（AOR=1.88，95% CI：1.60-2.22）。女童发生发育迟缓（AOR=0.92，95% CI：0.85-0.99）、体重不足（AOR=0.93，95% CI：0.86-1.00）和消瘦（AOR=0.84，95% CI：0.76-0.92）的几率低于男童。来自最富裕家庭的儿童发生发育迟缓（AOR=0.48，95% CI：0.41-0.56）、体重不足（AOR=0.50，95% CI：0.42-0.58）和消瘦（AOR=0.71，95% CI：0.59-0.86）的几率显著较低。母亲具有高中及以上教育对发育迟缓（AOR=0.57，95% CI：0.47-0.69）和体重不足（AOR=0.63，95% CI：0.51-0.76）具有保护作用。Sylhet地区儿童发生发育迟缓（AOR=1.37，95% CI：1.15-1.64）和体重不足（AOR=1.40，95% CI：1.18-1.67）的几率高于Barishal地区儿童。结论：家庭财富、儿童性别和出生顺序、母亲教育以及地理分区是孟加拉国儿童营养不良的主要相关因素。需要以公平为重点、针对特定地区的干预措施和持续的国家监测，以加快实现可持续发展目标2.2的进展。

papers.title: Parental Dementia History is Associated with Peripheral Immune Aging Rather than Generalized Biological and Brain Age Acceleration in Midlife
papers.translated_title: 父母痴呆史与中年期外周免疫衰老相关，而非与整体生物学和大脑年龄加速相关
papers.author: Winford, E. D.
papers.summary: Parental history of dementia is a risk factor for Alzheimer's disease, although the mechanisms underlying this association remain poorly understood. We hypothesize that differences in epigenetic aging may contribute to this increased risk. We examined DNA methylation (DNAm)-based measures of epigenetic aging, telomere length, immune cell composition, and MRI-based measures of brain aging in 1,204 middle-aged adults. Parental dementia history was not associated with accelerated epigenetic or brain aging. However, it was associated with CD8 memory T cell expansion, with nominal differences in CD4 memory T cells, memory B cells, and telomere length. The association with shorter telomere length was attenuated after accounting for CD8 memory T cells, supporting a CD8-specific relationship. Earlier parental dementia onset was associated with faster pace of biological aging, while poorer parental cognitive performance was associated with lower naive and higher memory immune cell proportions, accelerated epigenetic aging, and a larger brain age gap. These findings suggest that midlife adults with parental dementia history exhibit a peripheral immune aging signature characterized by a naive-to-memory T cell shift. Parental cognitive performance was also associated with accelerated epigenetic aging and brain age gap, suggesting that familial dementia risk is reflected across multiple aging dimensions in midlife offspring.
papers.translated_summary: 父母痴呆史是阿尔茨海默病的危险因素，尽管这一关联背后的机制仍知之甚少。我们假设表观遗传衰老的差异可能 contribute to 这种增加的风险。我们在1，204名中年成年人中检查了基于DNA甲基化（DNAm）的表观遗传衰老测量、端粒长度、免疫细胞组成以及基于MRI的脑衰老测量。父母痴呆史与加速的表观遗传衰老或脑衰老无关。然而，它与CD8记忆T细胞扩增相关，并在CD4记忆T细胞、记忆B细胞和端粒长度方面存在名义差异。在考虑CD8记忆T细胞后，与较短端粒长度的关联减弱，支持CD8特异性关系。较早的父母痴呆发病与更快的生物学衰老速度相关，而较差的父母认知表现与较低的初始和较高的记忆免疫细胞比例、加速的表观遗传衰老以及更大的脑年龄差距相关。这些发现表明，有父母痴呆史的中年成年人表现出以初始向记忆T细胞转变为特征的外周免疫衰老特征。父母认知表现也与加速的表观遗传衰老和脑年龄差距相关，表明家族性痴呆风险反映在中年子代的多个衰老维度上。

papers.title: Overweight in children under five in urban and wealthier households in Bangladesh: trends and inequalities across three Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys, 2012-13 to 2025
papers.translated_title: 孟加拉国城市和较富裕家庭五岁以下儿童超重：2012-13年至2025年三项多指标类集调查的趋势与不平等
papers.author: Hasan, M. K.
papers.summary: Background: Childhood overweight is often expected to emerge first among urban and wealthier populations during the nutrition transition. However, evidence on temporal trends in childhood overweight and the independent contributions of household wealth and urban residence in Bangladesh remains limited. Methods: We analysed data from 63,972 children aged 0-59 months with valid weight-for-height z-scores (WHZ) from the Bangladesh Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys (MICS) of 2012-13, 2019 and 2025. Overweight was defined as WHZ >+2 according to the 2006 WHO Child Growth Standards. We estimated survey-weighted prevalence, absolute and relative wealth inequalities, and prevalence ratios for urban versus rural residence using regression models adjusted for household wealth and other measured characteristics. We also assessed anthropometric data quality and conducted sensitivity analyses. Results: National overweight prevalence was 1.6% (95% CI 1.4-1.9) in 2012-13, 2.4% (2.2-2.7) in 2019 and 1.7% (1.5-2.0) in 2025. The 2019 peak was concentrated in urban Dhaka district, where one measurer recorded all 67 overweight cases and WHZ variability was high. Excluding this area, prevalence was 1.5%, 1.9% and 1.7%, respectively. The fully adjusted relative index of inequality for wealth remained similar across surveys: 3.66 (1.93-6.93), 3.55 (2.21-5.71) and 3.35 (2.02-5.54), with no evidence of temporal change (interaction p=0.974). The wealth-adjusted urban-to-rural prevalence ratio was 1.44 (1.01-2.06) in 2012-13 and 1.77 (1.40-2.24) in 2019, then fell to 0.72 (0.54-0.95) in 2025. Mean WHZ decreased by 0.16 (95% CI-0.19 to -0.13) between 2019 and 2025, while wasting prevalence increased from 9.8% to 12.9%. In 2025, 41.4% (35.3-47.7) of overweight children were also stunted. Conclusions: Childhood overweight showed no sustained national increase, but persistent wealth inequalities remained. The changing association with urban residence and concerns about measurement quality highlight the need for continued surveillance and stronger anthropometric quality assurance.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：在营养转型过程中，儿童超重通常被预期首先出现在城市和较富裕人群中。然而，关于孟加拉国儿童超重的时间趋势以及家庭财富和城市居住地的独立贡献的证据仍然有限。方法：我们分析了来自2012-13年、2019年和2025年孟加拉国多指标类集调查（MICS）的63,972名0-59月龄儿童的数据，这些儿童具有有效的年龄别身高Z评分（WHZ）。根据2006年WHO儿童生长标准，超重定义为WHZ>+2。我们估算了调查加权患病率、绝对和相对财富不平等，以及使用针对家庭财富和其他测量特征调整的回归模型得出的城市与农村居住地的患病率比。我们还评估了人体测量数据质量并进行了敏感性分析。结果：全国超重患病率在2012-13年为1.6%（95%CI 1.4-1.9），2019年为2.4%（2.2-2.7），2025年为1.7%（1.5-2.0）。2019年的峰值集中在城市达卡区，那里一名测量员记录了全部67例超重病例，且WHZ变异性较高。排除该地区后，患病率分别为1.5%、1.9%和1.7%。财富的完全调整相对不平等指数在各调查中保持相似：3.66（1.93-6.93）、3.55（2.21-5.71）和3.35（2.02-5.54），没有时间变化的证据（交互作用p=0.974）。财富调整后的城市与农村患病率比在2012-13年为1.44（1.01-2.06），2019年为1.77（1.40-2.24），然后在2025年降至0.72（0.54-0.95）。2019年至2025年间，平均WHZ下降了0.16（95%CI -0.19至-0.13），而消瘦患病率从9.8%上升至12.9%。2025年，41.4%（35.3-47.7）的超重儿童同时存在生长迟缓。结论：儿童超重没有显示持续的国家级增长，但财富不平等持续存在。与城市居住地关联的变化以及对测量质量的担忧凸显了持续监测和更强人体测量质量保证的必要性。
